entries.claim: VERDE was built by two people: Anuj Phulera (software and systems) and Aarav Choudhary (hardware and electronics).
evidence: app/components/TeamSection.tsx — team array lists both names, roles, and skill sets
entries.safe_wording: VERDE is a two-person build: I built the software, cloud pipeline, vision model and site; Aarav Choudhary designed the board, power delivery and physical build.
entries.attribution: Anuj Phulera: firmware, cloud pipeline, vision model, site. Aarav Choudhary: schematic, PCB layout, power delivery, physical build.

entries.claim: The site has an interactive Three.js background.
entries.source: README.md feature list and Three.js 0.162 badge
evidence: package.json has no three dependency
no `three` import in app/
app/components/NeuralField.tsx: getContext('2d'); comment: 'Pure canvas: no shaders, no WebGL context stolen from the product scenes.'
entries.safe_wording: The background is a custom 2D canvas particle lattice, built without WebGL so the product scenes keep the GPU.

entries.claim: The site displays live sensor telemetry from the farm.
evidence: app/api/telemetry/route.ts returns Math.random() values for every sensor, including uptime 99.97 and firmware V3.0.0
entries.safe_wording: The site includes a telemetry panel currently driven by simulated values, clearly labelled as a demonstration.

entries.claim: The site exposes five server routes: contact, health, stats, telemetry and weather.
evidence: app/api/{contact,health,stats,telemetry,weather}/route.ts
entries.safe_wording: Five small server routes handle contact, health, stats, telemetry and weather.

entries.claim: The project has a single verification command that typechecks, lints and builds.
evidence: package.json: "verify": "tsc --noEmit && next lint && next build"
entries.safe_wording: The project defines one verification command that chains typecheck, lint and a production build.

entries.claim: The site is fully accessible with keyboard navigation, skip links and reduced-motion support.
evidence: NeuralField.tsx checks prefers-reduced-motion
no audit artefact, no automated a11y test in the repository
entries.safe_wording: Some motion respects the reduced-motion preference; a full accessibility audit has not been run.

entries.claim: All third-party API keys stay on the server and are never shipped to the browser.
evidence: app/api/{db,gemini,openrouter,plant-id,weather}/route.ts read process.env
no NEXT_PUBLIC_ reference under app/
.env.example: 'These are read on the server only (app/api/*). They are never sent to the browser.'
entries.safe_wording: Every third-party key is read server-side inside API routes; none is exposed to the client bundle.

entries.claim: The dashboard shows live ESP32 sensor data and controls the pump and grow light.
evidence: requires Firebase credentials and a running board; cannot be exercised in this environment
entries.safe_wording: The dashboard is designed to read the farm's sensors and to control the pump and grow light.

entries.claim: The app has 18 page routes across three separate role areas.
evidence: 18 page.tsx routes under app/(auth), app/(dashboard) and role subfolders
10 API routes under app/api
entries.safe_wording: Eighteen routes across three role areas: customer, business and admin.

entries.claim: NIRMAAN is India's first AI-powered e-waste management platform.
evidence: no market study or citation in the repository
superlative cannot be verified and is unlikely to be true
entries.safe_wording: An AI-assisted e-waste pickup platform built for a 2026 competition.

entries.claim: First-time visitors see an 18-second cinematic loader.
evidence: GenesisLoader.tsx: duration = 5000 in v6, 4500 in all twelve later commits
18 seconds never appears in source
entries.safe_wording: First-time visitors see a short boot sequence of about four and a half seconds.

entries.claim: The loader has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback and a skip control.
evidence: at HEAD the string prefers-reduced-motion appears exactly once in the repository: inside README.md
entries.safe_wording: Reduced-motion handling is not implemented in this build; it is on the correction list.

entries.claim: The site is structured as a sixteen-act cinematic narrative.
evidence: 19 section components exist
no act counter or 16-part structure found in source
entries.safe_wording: A long-form marketing site built from short, titled sections that read as acts.

entries.claim: NIRMAN branding is fully separated from VERDE and RESONATE.
evidence: globals.css:44 'Verde & Resonate Elite Avant-Garde Cyber Overlays'
layout.tsx:45 'Verde & Resonate Master Cyber Overlays'
GenesisLoader.tsx:40 '0xVERDE_RESONATE_CORE'
Hero.tsx:184 renders 'VERDE_OS'
Hero.tsx:134 and GenesisLoader.tsx:121 carry VERDE's tagline
entries.safe_wording: This build inherits visual conventions and copy from earlier projects; separation is incomplete.

entries.claim: The platform has 34 routes.
evidence: 34 page.tsx routes counted in app/
entries.safe_wording: Thirty-four routes.
entries.attribution: Team project; the README credits four students. Individual contributions are not yet itemised.

entries.claim: The analysis is based on a survey of 250+ Indian teenagers.
evidence: SUBMISSION_PACK/SkillVerse_Raw_Data_250_Records.csv contains 262 lines including header, dated 2026-05-22
entries.safe_wording: The platform is built on 261 survey responses collected in May 2026.
entries.attribution: Team project; the README credits four students. Individual contributions are not yet itemised.

entries.claim: The platform is WCAG AA compliant.
evidence: no accessibility test, audit report, or conformance statement in the repository
prefers-reduced-motion appears in only a small number of files
entries.safe_wording: Accessibility work has started; no conformance audit has been run.
entries.attribution: Team project; the README credits four students. Individual contributions are not yet itemised.

entries.claim: Built in four weeks by four students at Colonel's Central Academy, Gurugram.
evidence: no external corroboration accessible
team composition is not recorded in the repository
entries.safe_wording: Built as a four-person team project in 2026.
entries.attribution: Team project; the README credits four students. Individual contributions are not yet itemised.

entries.claim: Eight distinct AI analysis pipelines power the product.
evidence: 13 Gemini-related and data API routes exist
the eight-pipeline grouping was not traced
entries.safe_wording: A set of AI-assisted analysis routes, including sentiment, pathway, report and translation.
entries.attribution: Team project; the README credits four students. Individual contributions are not yet itemised.

entries.claim: RESONATE uses three custom GLSL shader pairs.
evidence: artifacts/resonate/src/presentation/shaders/{glass,neural,singularity}.{vert,frag}
same three pairs duplicated in .migration-backup
entries.safe_wording: Three custom vertex/fragment shader pairs: glass, neural and singularity.

entries.claim: RESONATE is a live cinematic platform.
evidence: no homepage URL on the repository
no README at root
six consecutive commits are unresolved Vercel configuration
entries.safe_wording: An unshipped experiment: a shader-driven narrative that was built but never deployed.

entries.claim: The project is roughly 25 pages of scroll-driven narrative.
evidence: 52 page.tsx files across the artefact and the migration backup
no single canonical route map
entries.safe_wording: A large multi-route narrative, spread across a pnpm workspace and an earlier Next.js build.

entries.claim: The site has a custom audio engine.
evidence: app/audio.js — 245 lines of hand-written Web Audio
no audio library in dependencies
entries.safe_wording: A 245-line hand-written Web Audio engine, not a media element wrapper.

entries.claim: The site is a ten-chapter personal narrative.
evidence: routes: distance, dossier, finale, letter, lie, love, ritual, timeline, transmission, root
entries.safe_wording: Nine named chapters plus a title route.

entries.claim: The narrative uses fabricated dates presented as a log.
evidence: 9e3fea6 'timeline dates de-fabricated' replaces MAY 09 / JUN 21 / JUL 17 with DATE: NOT RECORDED / SOMETIME AFTER THAT / IDK WHEN
the log tag changes from 'LIVE' to 'PARTIAL RECOVERY'
entries.safe_wording: The timeline deliberately records missing dates as missing rather than inventing precision.

entries.claim: The site is publicly deployed and ready to share.
evidence: no deployment URL in the repository
no live URL could be fetched from this environment
entries.safe_wording: The build is complete; public deployment has not been verified.

entries.claim: The corpus contains 35 objects connected by 79 typed relations.
evidence: src/content/graph.ts: 35 node ids between NODES and EDGES; 79 edge entries in EDGES
entries.safe_wording: Thirty-five objects, seventy-nine typed relations.

entries.claim: The interface can take six structurally different forms.
evidence: src/modes: Codex, Console, Constellation, Lattice, Mosaic, Zen
entries.safe_wording: Six interface paradigms, from a dense mosaic board to a single-column codex.

entries.claim: Two different visitors provably receive different structures.
evidence: scripts/smoke.mjs bundles the real app with esbuild and renders it in jsdom, then plays three visitor types
scripts/live-check.mjs drives the built site with two visitors
scripts/screenshot.mjs exists for visual capture
entries.safe_wording: A headless harness renders the real app and asserts that different reading behaviour produces different structures.

entries.claim: The deployed site is reachable at the published GitHub Pages URL.
evidence: github.io is not reachable from this environment; HTTP 000
entries.safe_wording: A static deployment exists; reachability was not verified here.

entries.claim: The portfolio is complete and live.
entries.source: new repository name and profile README link
evidence: repository contains only a README at base commit 16fe5c9
entries.safe_wording: The portfolio is in preparation.

entries.claim: The profile README links to eight working project repositories.
evidence: API checks on 2026-10-21 returned 404 for all eight links on the new account
the projects live on the older account UCHIHA-MADARA-ANUJ
entries.safe_wording: The profile links are being migrated from an earlier account to a new one.

entries.claim: The site shows screenshots of the working product interfaces.
evidence: generate-screenshots.js builds each PNG from a hand-written SVG string via sharp; no browser, no app, no capture step
six generateSvg calls produce landing, map, ecobot, dashboard, profile, verification
entries.safe_wording: Six interface stills are illustrations rendered from SVG, not captures of a running application.

entries.claim: Team avatars are original, licensed assets.
evidence: fetch-avatars.js scrapes og:image / alphaCoders URLs from a page and downloads them
no licence record in the repository
entries.safe_wording: Team imagery has no recorded licence and must not be published until its source is confirmed.
